label: Bambu Lab P2S (through Bambu Connect)
step.connect: Install Bambu Connect on this computer.
step.bind: In Bambu Connect, add your P2S. Do this once.
step.send: Press Send to 3D printer. The file opens in Bambu Connect: check it there and start the print.
note: Bambu Connect is Bambu Lab’s own program for printing from other software, and the print starts from there.
confirm: OrcaSlicer prepared this with its P2S presets: {grams} g, {layers} layers.
confirm.next: Open it in Bambu Connect? Nothing prints until you start it there.
done: Sent to Bambu Connect. Check it there and start the print.
fail.orca: OrcaSlicer was not found on this computer. Install it, then try again.
fail.slice: OrcaSlicer could not prepare this print. {why}
fail.bed: This does not fit on the P2S’s bed.
fail.connect: Bambu Connect did not open. Install it, then try again.
